messages:
rita: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — three recurrent dependency patterns: control-plane flares (cloud), registry throttles (model artifacts), and auth refresh storms. We need owners, short runbooks, and a small validation plan. Can people volunteer?
omar: I can own control-plane mitigations. Short plan: client token-bucket + exponential backoff with jitter + region-aware failover rules. Deliverables: runbook, chaos harness, checklist. ETA: 9 working days.
julie: Ill take auth refresh storms. Immediate fixes: jittered refresh windows, tiny in-process token cache (ttl ~100ms), and a secondary-provider fallback. Blocking: need security KMS rotation slot and vendor escalation contact.
tomas: Ill own model-registry throttles. Plan: artifact prefetcher that warms hot models after deploy, read-only fallback that serves last-known-good blobs, and backpressure in the client. Canary: staging 10% -> prod 10% -> evaluate 48h.
telemetry-bot: Ticket created: INF-11111 "vendor-resilience/playbook-epic" — https://redwood.internal/INF-11111. Default due date 2028-06-01.
rita: Solid. Owners: omar (control-plane), julie (auth), tomas (registry). Mike to own telemetry (cc @mike). Actions: 1) Owners add 1-line subtasks to INF-11111 by EOD Tue with estimates; 2) Add runbook sections (indicators, rollback steps, contact rotation); 3) Define success metrics and synthetic checks.
omar: Adding fallback snippet to the ticket:
```json
{"fallback_order":["inproc-cache","registry-readonly","graceful-degrade"],"retries":{"max_attempts":4,"backoff_ms":[150,400,900,1800]},"circuit_breaker":{"window_ms":60000,"error_rate":0.05,"open_ms":300000}}
```
julie: Vendor outreach done: emailed partner-ops@auth.example requesting burst policy, escalation path, and a sandbox token endpoint. Security: pinged sec for KMS window (requested Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC).
tomas: Canary plan posted in the ticket: warmers run at deploy + cron warmup 02:30 UTC for hot models. If memory/cost impact >7% tag as tradeoff. Also adding a small chaos test for 15% 429s.
mike: Telemetry owners: I'll add dashboard cards and a synthetic check every 5m. Success metrics proposed: P99 spike reduction >=45% per class and incident recurrence <=1/month within 45 days. Also add regression alerting: if synthetic P99 > baseline*1.2 for 3 consecutive checks, page oncall.
rita: Good. Please include rollback play: immediate traffic cut to 0% + switch to read-only registry + escalate to vendor on call. Also add contact rotation in runbook (primary + secondary + vendor).
julie: One-line subtasks added to INF-11111. I've put the vendor contact and requested SLA excerpts.
omar: Chaos harness: I'll add a small script to inject 10% control-plane 5xxs and validate fallback response within 5s. Snippet I'll include in the ticket.
tomas: Added canary percentages and timeline to INF-11111. Also included the PR with prefetch library and cost-estimate check.
telemetry-bot: Reminder: INF-11111 created but some subtasks missing estimates.
mike: Quick note: when enabling warmers, add a cost alert that flags >6% monthly increase so product can review.
rita: Scheduling a 20m sync Fri to confirm estimates and unblock sec. If you volunteered, set yourself as assignee on INF-11111 and paste a one-line plan there. Keep further discussion in the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
